title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On this coordinate system, draw a new face and within this face, create a single loop. In this first loop, draw a circle with its center at coordinates [0.0355, 0.0355] and a radius of 0.0355. Scale the entire 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0709 to adjust the size of the circle. Rotate the scaled 2D sketch using the same Euler angles as the initial coordinate system, which are set to zero degrees, and translate it using the same translation vector, which is also set to zero. Extrude the 2D sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to transform it into a 3D cylindrical object. Ensure that the extrusion only occurs in one direction. This boolean operation will result in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are a length of 0.0709, a width of 0.0709, and a height of 0.75.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0355, 0.0355)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0355)  # Draw a circle with the given radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the result

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius
r = r.center(0.0355, 0.0355).circle(0.0355)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)
